svg.title: Five clinical measurements across three data views

cc:Work.dc:title: Five clinical measurements across three data views
cc:Work.dc:description: Five empirical distribution plots compare available, complete and imputed measurements. Hemoglobin has a visible imputation step because 52 missing values receive 12.65. Creatinine and blood urea show long right tails.

g.text: Five clinical measurements across three data views

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405460

g.text: Each step counts the share at or below a measured value. Steeper jumps mean more patients share that value.
